notes.title: Objector is on Sale!
notes.content:
[h1]You can get Objector on Steam Winter Sale -40% off![/h1]

Get the game at -40% price and experience the challenging platformer gameplay set in a world full of many threads!

[h2]Also, we would like to take this opportunity to wish you a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year, Objectors! Thank you for your support![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43235598/78f31d4c632c026523f70de340a0265b089ec847.png[/img]

Besides that, we have fixed one rare annoying bug, which looped the soundtrack over and over again after death.
